Travel notice for animal passengers

Travelers should keep pets calm, secure, and close to the travel desk team for safe handling before departure.

Please bring all papers and carrier details to the Companion Animal Travel Desk before boarding. <<FACT F118>> Staff will review the crate, check the animal's comfort, and give clear guidance for the journey. Please follow crew directions without delay, since steady routines help reduce stress for animals and people alike.

If a departure is delayed, the Companion Animal Travel Desk can help you understand the support available and what steps to take next. <<FACT F109>> For any concern about a pet, a carrier, or the transfer process, speak with the desk as early as you can so the team can assist you properly.
